decisions.reason: The award-winning hipress probe has early external validation, and the energy transition makes its geothermal prospects more valuable, so the firm should hold the option and invest further.
This standard single-U probe extends the geothermal line, costs little to keep on the market, and geothermal demand in Germany is still rising, so the option should stay open.
The probe surface technology supports the geothermal portfolio at low carrying cost, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.
Fire-protection steel profiles meet steady regulatory demand in construction and are a core strength of the firm, so keeping the product is cheap and sensible.
Slim steel profiles fit the architectural trend toward large glazed areas and use existing production capacity, so the option should be kept.
The decorative surface system is a more niche offering with uncertain uptake, but carrying it costs little, so keeping it open while demand clarifies is justified.
